tool.name: GeneFior Recompute
tool.description: Recompute detection statistics from existing GeneFíor results
tool.command: ## Reconstruct a results directory from the provided TSV files mkdir -p input_results/raw_outputs && cp '$detection_matrix' input_results/raw_outputs/detection_matrix.tsv && #if $evidence_matrix: cp '$evidence_matrix' input_results/raw_outputs/evidence_matrix.tsv && #end if #if $evidence_summary: cp '$evidence_summary' input_results/raw_outputs/evidence_summary.tsv && #end if #if $allele_resolution: cp '$allele_resolution' input_results/raw_outputs/allele_resolution.tsv && #end if #if $query_fasta: cp '$query_fasta' input_results/raw_outputs/query.fasta && #end if mkdir -p output_dir && GeneFior-recompute -i input_results -o output_dir #if $tools: --tools #echo ' '.join($tools)# #end if --q-min-cov $q_min_cov --q-min-id $q_min_id --d-min-cov $d_min_cov --d-min-id $d_min_id --d-min-depth $d_min_depth --d-min-reads $d_min_reads #if str($report_fasta) != 'None': --report-fasta '$report_fasta' #end if #if str($report_read_names) != 'None': --report-read-names '$report_read_names' #end if #if $query_fasta: --query-fasta input_results/raw_outputs/query.fasta #end if && cd output_dir && find . -name '*_detection_matrix.tsv' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../recomputed_detection_matrix.tsv && find . -name '*_evidence_matrix.tsv' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../recomputed_evidence_matrix.tsv && cd .. && zip -r results_archive.zip output_dir

param.name: detection_matrix
param.label: Detection matrix from prior run
param.help: The *_detection_matrix.tsv file from a GeneFíor or AMRfior run

param.name: report_read_names
param.label: Report read names
param.help: Export deduplicated read names at the specified level

param.name: query_fasta
param.label: Query FASTA
param.help: Original query sequences for FASTA reporting
